messages:
rachel: Heads-up — deploy-bot blocked the release cut. Validation failed: manifest digest mismatch for redwood/inference:canary-20260325.

ci-agent: Publish step logged: pushed manifest sha256:77aa33 at 11:02:10Z. Mirror sync job logged a blob-fetch 502 and then wrote a new manifest sha256:88bb44 at 11:03:01Z.

deploy-bot: system: promotion halted - manifest-consistency-check failed for tag 'canary-20260325'. Lock held.

sam: Can we pin to the primary digest and run quick smoke? Change window opens in 20m.

infra-bot: Recommended immediate checklist: 1) confirm primary digest via skopeo; 2) HEAD test top blobs on mirrors; 3) if >=2 endpoints report 200 for primary blobs, promote with digest pin; 4) run 3-replica smoke per region; 5) open INFRA ticket.

rachel: Running checks now. primary digest = sha256:77aa33. mirror-eu currently shows 88bb44 but rechecked -> 77aa33. Blob HEADs (top2) all 200 across registry and mirrors.

sam: Good. I'll run promote with digest pin and force unlock.

sam: `deploy-bot promote --tag canary-20260325 --expected-digest sha256:77aa33 --force-unlock` -> done. deploy-bot: promotion resumed by @sam, promo-id=promo-1751111111-1.

ci-agent: Starting smoke (eu-west 3 replicas). Pulls: r1 ok, r2 transient 504 then ok, r3 ok. No 404s observed.

rachel: Creating INFRA ticket INFRA-2400 for mirror replication verification & to add pre-promotion mirror HEAD checks to runbook. Release window unblocked.

deploy-bot: promotion completed; release cleared.

rachel: Thanks all — closing thread. :thumbsup:
